scope: Read-only inspection of the exact original external-snapshot consumer helper and existing local producer locators. No remote file acquisition, original large descriptor read, physical provider read, Lean, proof replay or five-tool re-audit.

producer_locator.basis: Atlas explicitly confirmed that only the a57b consumer and exact ad438 descriptor path are reliably located in current materials. The scoped filename search in p29-current/known-drivers and p29-atlas-1126 found no additional named snapshot producer.

required_schema.context_signature: SHA256 of canonical JSON for the entire top-level value excluding only context_signature; additional top-level fields are included in this signature.

field_table.enforced: Every N has one of the native prefixes MathlibNt, AnalyticNumberTheory, PrimeNumberTheoremAnd, Goldbach, Architect. Its package is one of the two pinned native packages. source and object point into files; object ends in .olean. Source imports are reread with the original source parser. Native imports are transitively present in modules; dependency_signatures and closure_signature bind those native dependencies, this module's source/object SHA and provider metadata.
field_table.header_semantics: modules[N].imports is the parsed source import list, not an asserted Lean ModuleData/header direct_imports field. Dependency signatures are formed only for the native-prefix portion of that list.

field_table.scope: Physical-file map, not restricted to native names or source/object files
field_table.enforced: Every listed path is absolute and its bytes/SHA are checked against the actual file in verify(), using device/inode/size/mtime/ctime-aware hashing. Mandatory members include the runtime binaries, qualification receipt, native source/object files and each native provider receipt. The source does not prohibit additional standard .olean, private/server/IR facets, sources or receipt files.
field_table.coverage_limit: No module or facet column is required by this map. A standard/facet row can be reused if it is actually present and linked to the corresponding module, but the helper source does not establish which additional rows the original descriptor contains.

field_table.scope: At least all native modules; permitted to include standard module names
field_table.enforced: Every native module must occur and equal modules[N].object. verify_resolutions iterates every resolutions entry without a native-prefix filter, requires its expected path in files, and resolves N.replace('.', '/')+'.olean' through the fixed search roots. It checks the chosen physical file and rejects an earlier incomplete package root that would shadow it.
field_table.coverage_limit: This is a base-.olean resolution relation. There is no required complete standard closure or required five-facet relation for every N. Actual standard keys must be inspected; they cannot be inferred from the native module count.

field_table.enforced: The selected Lean and Mathlib pin match the caller; Lean/checker binaries are in files. The effective search order is the current project_lib followed by resolved runtime.lean_path roots, with no repeated roots and an explicit sysroot/lib/lean entry. environment() selects that sysroot/search path and clears LEAN_SRC_PATH.
field_table.coverage_limit: A search root is not itself a complete per-module facet/header inventory.

field_table.scope: Exactly two pinned native source packages
field_table.enforced: Package keys are exactly goldbach and LeanArchitect, their declared commits match fixed PINS, and verify() checks their current Git HEAD. These checks are separate from files/resolutions and do not limit those maps to native physical files.

status must be ALL_REQUIRED_NATIVE_PROVIDERS_QUALIFIED; its receipt path and SHA are present in files. This helper freezes that receipt but does not manufacture a new normal/kernel/full-owned proof acceptance.
status is EXACT_ORIGINAL_IMPORTS_REBOUND or FRESH_PRIVATE_SOURCE_COMPILATION; receipt is physically frozen through files. The entire provider value participates in the native closure signature.
field_table.coverage_limit: Additional producer or original-header fields may exist inside provider or its referenced receipt. The consumer does not require or enumerate such fields, and this review has not read their raw data.

field_table.path: binding() output, as embedded in original audit input_snapshot.external_snapshot
field_table.scope: A compact reference to the raw descriptor
field_table.enforced: native_modules is only sorted(modules). The full files and resolutions maps are intentionally absent from this compact binding.
field_table.implication: The previous finding that the audit receipt itself lacks a complete facet/header graph remains correct. It does not imply that the referenced raw ad438 descriptor lacks usable standard byte bindings.

source_only_conclusions.reason: The helper never requires actual_modules, parts, is_module or compiled-header direct_imports for all modules. It also does not whitelist top-level or nested keys: extra recorded graphs/headers would be covered by context_signature and may be present. Only the actual descriptor/producer provenance can settle that.
source_only_conclusions.reuse_recommendation: Keep files/resolutions and any original extra header/facet data as candidates for exact reuse. Do not trigger a replacement full input binding merely because the compact audit binding has only native_modules.

pending_raw_data_checks.check: On receipt of the unique archive, verify the original ad438 descriptor bytes/SHA and its archive member binding, then verify its context_signature using the original canonical encoding. Do not infer contents from 20904189 bytes or 515 names.

Inspect actual top-level keys and the shapes/counts of modules, files, resolutions, runtime, qualification and provider fields. Distinguish native modules from extra standard resolutions; record any actual compiled-header or explicit facet arrays if present.

For each actual resolutions[N], join files[expected_path] to obtain exact bytes/SHA. Enumerate companion .olean.server/.olean.private/.ir.sig/.ir entries actually present in files and link them using original paths/module metadata. Do not count source or JSON receipt rows as compiler facets or invent missing companions.

Establish where the selected actual import closure and compiled header/isModule information comes from: an explicit descriptor field, a frozen original provider/checkpoint receipt, a reliably located producer, or an already accepted identical-object header graph. Native source imports alone do not establish all standard compiled headers.

Compare actual coverage with the selected Omitted roots and already accepted P1/Fibre identities, ignoring mere path inequality for byte equality. Reuse any complete already-bound subgraph instead of regenerating it. Keep the standard/native coverage result separate from new two-root owned proof acceptance.
